userBearer.description: 用户 OAuth 访问令牌；服务端校验 workspace 成员和资源归属。

browserSession.name: auro_auth
browserSession.description: Auro 宿主的 auro_auth Cookie；写请求另需 X-CSRF-Token。独立宿主在部署文档中声明自己的会话认证适配。

gameBearer.description: 通过一次性启动码兑换，只能读取指定游戏会话和其资源。

WorkspaceId.name: X-Workspace-ID
WorkspaceId.description: 宿主 workspace 选择器。被令牌固定的 workspace 优先；不能扩大授权。

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 相同调用重试复用 UUID；不同内容或下一次独立操作使用新 UUID。

Problem.description: 统一错误；见技术文档错误码表。

PointMm.description: Integer millimetres. +X right, +Y down; local +X is forward. Convert to metres only at the runtime boundary.

Transform.description: Position and orientation in the parent coordinate frame. Positive rotation is clockwise; 90000 mdeg is 90 degrees.

Part.description: Unique part ID; parentId is null for the single root. Parent references must be acyclic. Array order is render order.

Cannon.description: Exactly one cannon in v1. The barrel is a box, length 1600-3200 mm and width 450-1050 mm in 50 mm increments. Muzzle is at barrel-local {x:lengthMm/2,y:0}, rotationMdeg=0.

CharacterDefinition.description: tracked-tank@1 has hull root, two track parts, one turret and one barrel, with tracked mobility. fixed-turret@1 has base root, one turret and one barrel, with static mobility. Turret parents to root; barrel parents to turret.

AssetDescriptor.description: Immutable, authorized, completed upload. SHA-256 covers original image bytes. Metadata must exactly match the registered asset.

CharacterDraft.description: Strict portable character content. No map/session IDs, URLs, credentials, scripts, mass, HP, speed, damage or cooldown. Numeric content is safe integers; game rules derive combat values.

draftSchema.description: Self-contained JSON Schema 2020-12; no external references.
